description: List/search contacts across the account. Paginated, with optional email/name/campaign filters, sort, and a fields selector. REST: GET /contacts.

campaignId.description: Restrict to contacts in this campaign (list) id (→ query[campaignId]).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return, e.g. "name,email" (GetResponse `fields`).

sortCreatedOn.description: Sort by created date ASC/DESC (→ sort[createdOn]).

name: getresponse_list_contacts
